description: Utilvo is a privacy-preserving client-side biomedical imaging and scientific information processing suite developed by Islam Ayoub (ORCID: 0009-0002-1503-5639). Executed entirely within the browser sandbox using WebAssembly (Wasm), WebGL2, Web Workers, and the Web Cryptography API, Utilvo enables zero-trust local inspection of clinical DICOM (.dcm) radiology studies, 3D NIfTI (.nii / .nii.gz) neuroimaging volumes, 12-lead ECG/EKG waveform recordings, and structured research documents without transmitting raw patient data (PHI) to external servers.
